nodes.label: UBench
nodes.summary: Computer-vision pipeline for thermal facial region segmentation (10 classes, Portuguese labels) that trains and benchmarks U-Net, TransUNet and Swin-UNet++ under one unified training loop.

nodes.label: CLAUDE.md
nodes.summary: Project orientation guide merged with the engineering & remediation program; §1-§4 describe the repo, §5-§12 govern how work is done.

nodes.label: CLAUDE.md §3 Commands & Environment
nodes.summary: Venv-only environment setup, entry points and flag forwarding, running stages directly, fast dev loops, and the lint/unit/E2E gates.

nodes.label: CLAUDE.md §4 Architecture
nodes.summary: Execution flow, config authority, hardware auto-scaling, dataset discovery, splits, shared training loop and per-family recipes, run identity, imports, thermal preprocessing.

nodes.label: CLAUDE.md §5 Known-Defect Ledger
nodes.summary: The single source of truth for verified defects UB-01..UB-30, each with severity, location, verified behaviour and status.

nodes.label: CLAUDE.md §6 Non-Negotiable Engineering Rules
nodes.summary: Rules R1-R10 governing verification, testing, diff scope, failure paths, sources of truth, commits, style, security, docs and honesty.

nodes.label: CLAUDE.md §7 Testing Doctrine
nodes.summary: Test layout and conventions, the synthetic-dataset fixture spec, the smoke test as merge gate, and the CI workflow.

nodes.label: CLAUDE.md §8 ML & Benchmark Methodology Standards
nodes.summary: Standards M1-M9 on splits, metrics, timing, fairness, pretraining, reproducibility, thermal preprocessing, statistics and honest reporting.

nodes.label: CLAUDE.md §9 Phased Task Plan
nodes.summary: Execution order and acceptance criteria for Phases 0-5 and their tasks.

nodes.label: CLAUDE.md §10 Verification Gates & Definition of Done
nodes.summary: Session Entry Protocol, per-task gates, per-phase gates and the project Definition of Done.

nodes.label: CLAUDE.md §11 Anti-Patterns
nodes.summary: Forbidden actions: undemonstrated done-claims, weakened tests, widened exceptions, display-derived filenames, second config file, full-scale CI training, fabricated metrics.

nodes.label: R1 — Verify empirically
nodes.summary: Every 'X works / X is fixed' claim must be backed by a command run in the session and its observed output; otherwise prefix UNVERIFIED:.

nodes.label: R2 — Test first
nodes.summary: For every ledger item: failing test (red) -> minimal fix (green) -> refactor -> keep the test. A fix without a regression test is not accepted.

nodes.label: R3 — Minimal, surgical diffs
nodes.summary: Fix the defect only; no wholesale reformatting, renaming or opportunistic improvement. Most P0 fixes are under 15 lines.

nodes.label: R4 — No silent failure paths
nodes.summary: Never widen try/except, add .get(key, default) or insert a fallback to hide an error; prefer hard lookups that raise and non-zero exit codes.

nodes.label: R5 — One source of truth per contract
nodes.summary: Filenames, config keys and model identifiers are defined once and imported everywhere; the registry name is the canonical model_key for all file I/O.

nodes.label: R6 — Conventional commits, one ledger item per commit/PR
nodes.summary: Commit messages follow conventional-commit form naming the ledger id, and the ledger Status is updated in the same commit.

nodes.label: R7 — Style & typing
nodes.summary: Python >=3.10, type hints on new/modified signatures, ruff clean, Google-style docstrings describing actual behaviour, absolute imports rooted at codes.

nodes.label: R8 — Security & safety defaults
nodes.summary: torch.load(weights_only=True) for all weight loading, validate archive member names before extraction, never execute code from data files.

nodes.label: R9 — Documentation follows code
nodes.summary: Any behaviour change updates README/docstrings/CLAUDE.md in the same PR; docs must never describe behaviour the code does not implement.

nodes.label: R10 — Honest AI collaboration
nodes.summary: Do not fabricate benchmark numbers, invent training runs or extrapolate metrics; truncated runs produce smoke artifacts, never results.

nodes.label: M1 — Splits
nodes.summary: Subject-level grouping is mandatory; guard n_splits = min(K_FOLDS, n_groups) with a warning, error below 2 groups, and hold out opt-in test_subjects that never select a model.

nodes.label: M2 — Metrics
nodes.summary: One definition per metric shared by trainer and benchmark via torchmetrics on argmax: hard IoU + Dice, macro excluding absent classes, background separate, loss = CE+Dice.

nodes.label: M3 — Timing
nodes.summary: GPU latency measured with cuda.synchronize before and after, at least 5 warm-up batches discarded, reported mean±std with batch size, dtype, GPU and torch version; never compare VRAM at unequal batch sizes.

nodes.label: M4 — Fairness
nodes.summary: Per-family recipes fully disclosed (CNN Adam/plateau, transformers AdamW wd~0.05 + warmup->cosine, grad-clip 1.0), best checkpoint chosen by val mIoU, equal disclosed budget.

nodes.label: M5 — Pretraining policy
nodes.summary: Prefer library-pretrained encoders (timm R50+ViT-B/16, timm/MONAI Swin) with 1-channel input adapted by summing pretrained RGB stem kernels; do not hand-roll attention.

nodes.label: M6 — Reproducibility
nodes.summary: Single seed_everything owner, seeded DataLoader generator + worker_init_fn, one owner for cudnn.benchmark, lockfiles for CPU and CUDA, and per-run provenance metadata.

nodes.label: M7 — Thermal-domain preprocessing
nodes.summary: Normalization switch per_image_minmax|fixed_range with fixed_range [20,40]°C recommended, array-native raw->°C, and physically plausible additive drift + Gaussian noise instead of brightness/contrast.

nodes.label: M8 — Statistical claims
nodes.summary: 'Outperforms' requires mean±std across folds on held-out test subjects plus a paired Wilcoxon signed-rank with reported p, computed by the report generator, not prose.

nodes.label: M9 — Honest reporting
nodes.summary: Every table/plot states dataset+split protocol, params, pretraining status, budget, batch size, hardware and torch version; smoke artifacts are labelled and never mixed into the benchmark history.

nodes.label: Phase 0 — Safety net
nodes.summary: Build the test suite, synthetic fixture, smoke test, CI and ruff config before touching any bug.

nodes.label: Phase 1 — Make ./run.sh work (P0)
nodes.summary: Close the blockers so a fresh clone runs end to end honestly: preprocessing, filename contract, batch keys, folds, mask offsets, failure honesty, resume, run identity.

nodes.label: Phase 2 — Trustworthy numbers (P1)
nodes.summary: Make the measurements honest: synchronized warm-up timing, one metric authority, fixed-batch VRAM, held-out test subjects, seeded reproducibility, dead-code removal.

nodes.label: Phase 3 — Credible science (P2)
nodes.summary: Single validated config, library-pretrained encoders, per-family recipes with mIoU selection, honest thermal preprocessing, lockfiles, package-clean imports, README reconciliation.

nodes.label: Phase 4 — Enhancements
nodes.summary: Post-green enhancements: Wilcoxon in the report generator, TensorBoard, packaging/entry points, modern AMP, ONNX export, mypy in CI.

nodes.label: Phase 5 — Post-run corrections
nodes.summary: Defects found by analysing the reported run's results rather than by reading code; the run's artifacts stay frozen and the defects are disclosed, not retro-fixed.

nodes.label: T0.1 — tests skeleton + synthetic fixture + smoke test
nodes.summary: Created codes/tests/, the synthetic fixture and the smoke test as a failing test tracked with xfail(strict=True) against UB-01's FileNotFoundError.

nodes.label: T0.2 — un-ignore tests, add __init__, CI + ruff
nodes.summary: Un-ignored codes/tests and CLAUDE.md, added package __init__ files, the CI workflow and pyproject with ruff config.

nodes.label: T1.1 — auto preprocessing
nodes.summary: Pipeline invokes preprocess_all_data() when metadata.csv is absent, adds --force-preprocess, and the README gains the step.

nodes.label: T1.2 — naming.py checkpoint contract
nodes.summary: Introduced codes/naming.py:checkpoint_path so trainer and benchmark share one filename authority keyed by model_key.

nodes.label: T1.3 — canonical batch-size keys
nodes.summary: Registry keys in hardware_detector with hard [key] lookup replacing .get(k, 8), plus test-enforced per-tier key parity.

nodes.label: T1.4 — fold-count guard
nodes.summary: effective_k = min(K, n_groups) with a loud warning, hard error below 2 subjects, and the README rewritten to leave-subjects-out CV.

nodes.label: T1.5 — clamped crop origin
nodes.summary: Clamped origin computed once and returned by crop_to_bbox so the mask offset matches the crop for border-adjacent bounding boxes.

nodes.label: T1.6 — failure honesty
nodes.summary: Failure registry, end-of-run summary, non-zero exit on any failure, --fail-fast, and Pipeline() moved inside main()'s try.

nodes.label: T1.7 — resume
nodes.summary: --resume <run_id> reuses the run's dirs and checkpoints, metric history continues, and outputs/latest symlinks the newest run.

nodes.label: T1.8 — run identity and --epochs
nodes.summary: --epochs default=None so any value is honored, and run.sh exports UBENCH_RUN_ID which Python reuses for one run-dir pair.

nodes.label: T2.1 — honest timing
nodes.summary: Removed per-epoch timing from validate() and added warm-up discard plus CUDA sync to the benchmark via timed_inference.

nodes.label: T2.2 — one metric authority
nodes.summary: Shared codes/metrics.py used by trainer and benchmark, with the benchmark loss switched to CombinedLoss.

nodes.label: T2.3 — fixed-batch VRAM probe
nodes.summary: probe_peak_memory runs one inference forward on a synthetic (4,1,H,W) batch shared by all models; CPU reports n/a rather than a fabricated 0.

nodes.label: T2.4 — held-out test subjects
nodes.summary: test_subjects excluded from all CV folds, each fold-model scored on the held-out set, and the report gains CV and TEST sections.

nodes.label: T2.5 — determinism and run metadata
nodes.summary: Seeded DataLoader generator + worker_init_fn, a single cuDNN owner behind the deterministic flag, and run_metadata.json per run.

nodes.label: T2.6 — dead code and scratch sweep
nodes.summary: Deleted dead code and scratch scripts, removed inference_comparison.py, fixed the panel grid, made normalize_thermal return zeros at min==max, and slimmed checkpoints.

nodes.label: T3.1 — one validated config
nodes.summary: Deleted the root config.yaml, added a pydantic schema over codes/config.yaml that rejects unknown keys, and wired loss/optimizer/scheduler/class_weights.

nodes.label: T3.2 — pretrained encoders
nodes.summary: Registered swin_pretrained (timm SwinV2-tiny) and transunet_pretrained (timm R50+ViT-B/16) with 1-channel stem adaptation by summing RGB kernels.

nodes.label: T3.3 — per-family recipes
nodes.summary: Per-family optimizer/scheduler recipes resolved from config, kind-specific scheduler cadence, checkpoint selection by val mIoU, and a resume recipe-mismatch guard.

nodes.label: T3.4 — thermal preprocessing and augmentation
nodes.summary: Load-time normalization over a Celsius .npy store guarded by a manifest version, physical additive augmentation, vectorized raw->°C, and the registry-derived --models fix.

nodes.label: T3.5 — lockfiles
nodes.summary: Dependencies single-sourced in pyproject, a committed CPU lock installed via uv pip sync, backend-aware setup.py, and lockfile sha256 recorded in run_metadata.json.

nodes.label: T3.6 — absolute imports
nodes.summary: Absolute imports rooted at codes., removal of sys.path hacks and dual-import fallbacks, package execution via python -m, and model __main__ self-tests.

nodes.label: T3.7 — README reconciliation
nodes.summary: Reconciled the README's stale half to the code: Python versions, lock install, quickstart, result trees, expected output, preprocessing stage and troubleshooting.

nodes.label: T4.1 — Wilcoxon paired test in report generator
nodes.summary: Open task: add the paired Wilcoxon signed-rank test to the report generator so significance claims are computed, not asserted.

nodes.label: T4.2 — TensorBoard logging
nodes.summary: Open enhancement task for TensorBoard logging.

nodes.label: T4.3 — packaging and CLI entry points
nodes.summary: Open task: pyproject packaging with ubench train|benchmark entry points.

nodes.label: T4.4 — modern AMP
nodes.summary: Open task: torch.amp.GradScaler('cuda') and bf16 on Ampere+.

nodes.label: T4.5 — ONNX export
nodes.summary: Open task: ONNX export plus a deployment-latency table.

nodes.label: T4.6 — mypy in CI
nodes.summary: Open task: add mypy to the CI gate.

nodes.label: T5.1 — resolve landmark scheme per image
nodes.summary: Landmark scheme resolved from the landmarks each row fills rather than the CSV header, with unknown counts raising instead of defaulting to 73.

nodes.label: T5.2 — isolate the VRAM probe
nodes.summary: VRAM probe reports own parameters plus working-set delta with a discarded warm-up forward, so other resident models cannot inflate it.

nodes.label: T5.3 — re-measurement scripts for the dissertation
nodes.summary: Open task: scripts a09-a12 producing per-subject final-epoch metrics, the mask-defect census, isolated VRAM and the Chapter-5 figures under data/outputs/.

nodes.label: T5.4 — resolve the visible facial side
nodes.summary: Visible side of a profile frame derived from landmark geometry and validated on the real corpus, so the lateral pair never shares an index range.

nodes.label: T5.5 — lateral-aware horizontal flip
nodes.summary: Horizontal flip mirrors and permutes the lateral class pairs atomically so the label follows the pixels across the midline.

nodes.label: UB-01 — preprocessing never invoked
nodes.summary: Blocker: preprocess_data.py was never invoked by any entry point while loaders required data/processed/metadata.csv, so a fresh clone failed 15/15 train attempts. FIXED@03e6dbb.

nodes.label: UB-02 — checkpoint filename contract mismatch
nodes.summary: Blocker: training saved registry-named weights while the benchmark searched display-name filenames, so the comparison silently contained 1 of 3 models. FIXED@dd5fa8d.

nodes.label: UB-03 — GroupKFold raises when subjects < K
nodes.summary: Blocker: GroupKFold(n_splits=K_FOLDS) with groups=df['dataset'] raised ValueError whenever the number of datasets was below K (default 5). FIXED@73967c8.

nodes.label: UB-04 — split semantics contradict docs
nodes.summary: Blocker/Docs: code does leave-subjects-out while the README described a stratified per-dataset split with fold counts GroupKFold cannot produce. FIXED@73967c8.

nodes.label: UB-05 — batch-size key mismatch
nodes.summary: Blocker: batch-size keys {unet, transunet, swin} versus the lookup swin_unet_plus_plus meant .get(key, 8) silently returned 8, risking OOM at the advertised 6 GB minimum. FIXED@cd3afa4.

nodes.label: UB-06 — auto-resume dead across restarts
nodes.summary: Major: a new timestamp per invocation meant _find_latest_checkpoint() scanned an empty dir; numpy scalars in the metric history also broke weights_only=True loading. FIXED@01244fa.

nodes.label: UB-07 — failures swallowed
nodes.summary: Major: per-model/fold try/except printed one line and continued, so a SUCCESS banner and exit 0 were possible with zero trained models. FIXED@74e1b43.

nodes.label: UB-08 — unclamped polygon offset shifts masks
nodes.summary: Major: the polygon offset bbox.min-10 was unclamped while the crop origin used max(0,...), shifting masks up to 10 px for border-adjacent faces. Silent label corruption. FIXED@cc890de.

nodes.label: UB-09 — unsynced per-epoch inference timing
nodes.summary: Major: validate() timed inference without cuda.synchronize (measuring launch, including loss) and the benchmark discarded no warm-up batches. FIXED@bc01d07.

nodes.label: UB-10 — VRAM compared at unequal batch sizes
nodes.summary: Major: peak VRAM was compared across models trained at different batch sizes, worsened by UB-05. FIXED@3bbe8df.

nodes.label: UB-11 — inconsistent metric definitions
nodes.summary: Major: hard IoU versus soft Dice over softmax including background on unweighted ragged batches, and a CE-only benchmark loss against the training CE+Dice. FIXED@3260638.

nodes.label: UB-12 — config drift
nodes.summary: Major: the root YAML was loaded by nothing, training.batch_sizes was unconsumed, CLASS_WEIGHTS had no producer, and scheduler/optimizer were hardcoded. FIXED@72c59f4.

nodes.label: UB-13 — --epochs 100 ignored
nodes.summary: Minor: main_pipeline guarded with `if args.epochs != 100`, so an explicit --epochs 100 was dropped; the fix is default=None. FIXED@add5229.

nodes.label: UB-14 — two timestamps per run
nodes.summary: Minor: shell and Python each minted a timestamp, producing duplicate logs/<ts> dirs and a final message pointing at the wrong one. FIXED@add5229.

nodes.label: UB-15 — dead code
nodes.summary: Minor: train_iou_metric never updated, calculate_iou unused, no-op load_shared_data, an 11-panels-in-10-axes grid, and normalize_thermal returning an un-normalized image at min==max. FIXED@5991f60.

nodes.label: UB-16 — ViT-B trained from scratch
nodes.summary: Method: ~100M-parameter ViT-B trained from scratch on ~1.8k images with plain Adam and no warmup/wd/dropout, guaranteeing transformer underperformance and invalidating fairness claims. FIXED@faa9a2d.

nodes.label: UB-17 — defective Swin attention
nodes.summary: Method: shifted windows without an attention mask, no relative position bias or positional embedding, CNN decoder, no deep supervision, a redundant nested column and a final 4x bilinear jump. Superseded rather than repaired. FIXED@faa9a2d.

nodes.label: UB-18 — unfair identical hyperparameters
nodes.summary: Method: identical hyperparameters across families, best checkpoint chosen by val loss rather than the headline mIoU, and selection plus reporting on the same folds. FIXED@b74ef7d.

nodes.label: UB-19 — thermal preprocessing destroys temperature
nodes.summary: Method: per-image min-max destroyed absolute temperature, RandomBrightnessContrast is physically dubious on thermal, and np.vectorize made raw->°C a per-pixel Python loop. FIXED@5f8e15b.

nodes.label: UB-20 — reproducibility and environment defects
nodes.summary: Method/Env: no DataLoader generator or worker_init_fn, a cudnn.benchmark contradiction, unpinned >= deps, --force-reinstall --no-deps torch against an aging cu121 index, and system-Python installs. Closed via 20a and 20b.

nodes.label: UB-20a — determinism sub-item
nodes.summary: Seeded DataLoader generator and worker_init_fn, a single cuDNN owner behind the deterministic flag, and per-run metadata. FIXED@c85a5c5.

nodes.label: UB-20b — dependency/lockfile sub-item
nodes.summary: Deps single-sourced in pyproject, a committed CPU lock installed via uv pip sync, no system-Python installs, backend-aware index, and lock sha256 in run_metadata. FIXED@0cc7724.

nodes.label: UB-21 — three import styles
nodes.summary: Hygiene: three import styles, no __init__.py, and model files that crashed when run directly because of relative imports. FIXED@1800abf.

nodes.label: UB-22 — scratch scripts committed, tests gitignored
nodes.summary: Hygiene: scratch scripts committed, inference_comparison.py orphaned, codes/tests gitignored while pytest was required, and CLAUDE.md gitignored. FIXED@d81b7a3.

nodes.label: UB-23 — hardware detector exits on CPU
nodes.summary: Blocker: detect() called sys.exit(1) when CUDA was unavailable, contradicting the CPU-first doctrine and blocking CI E2E; fixed with an explicit UBENCH_ALLOW_CPU=1 opt-in. FIXED@af14b13.

nodes.label: UB-24 — stray top-level output dirs
nodes.summary: Hygiene: preprocess_all_data built a default Config whose constructor mkdir'd top-level outputs/{models,plots,predictions} beside the real run dirs. FIXED@3b5d69e.

nodes.label: UB-25 — checkpoint disk bloat in tests
nodes.summary: Hygiene: full-suite runs persisted 10-15 GB of full-state checkpoints across retained pytest temp dirs, turning near-full disks into spurious ENOSPC failures. FIXED@0d12ca1.

nodes.label: UB-26 — hand-maintained --models choices
nodes.summary: Blocker/Docs: argparse choices ['unet','transunet','swin'] was a second authority that rejected the registered pretrained keys the docs advertise, blocking the GPU-box run. FIXED@dc3fe29.

nodes.label: UB-27 — landmark scheme chosen per file
nodes.summary: Method/Blocker: the scheme came from the CSV header's x-column count, always 73, so LANDMARK_MAPPINGS_43 never executed and ~50% profile rows were rasterized through the wrong mapping, corrupting mouth/lips/forehead/eye classes. FIXED@9712d2c.

nodes.label: UB-28 — VRAM probe not isolated
nodes.summary: Major: max_memory_allocated is device-wide and reset_peak_memory_stats re-seeds to the currently allocated total, so each probe was charged for every previously loaded model, inverting the VRAM ordering. FIXED@da23a47.

nodes.label: UB-29 — 43-point mapping double-books lateral indices
nodes.summary: Method/Blocker: the 43-point mapping shared indices 12-15 for both eyebrows and 22-26 for both eyes, so painting in REGION_NAMES order would erase one side; the profile scheme annotates only the visible side. FIXED@9376336.

nodes.label: UB-30 — horizontal flip does not permute lateral labels
nodes.summary: Method/Blocker: the flip mirrored image and mask identically while labels are image-side, so class 5 meant both left and right eye in training, capping the four lateral classes near chance and depressing every reported mIoU. FIXED@831c04d.

nodes.label: run.sh
nodes.summary: Linux/Mac entry point; handles --skip-extract/--skip-setup itself, forwards the rest to main_pipeline, exports its timestamp as UBENCH_RUN_ID, and writes console.log.

nodes.label: run.bat
nodes.summary: Windows entry point mirroring run.sh; its UBENCH_RUN_ID export is UNVERIFIED for lack of a Windows box.

nodes.label: codes/main_pipeline.py
nodes.summary: Orchestrator holding the Pipeline class: run-id resolution, hardware detection, auto-preprocessing, per-model/fold training, failure registry and benchmark invocation.

nodes.label: codes/setup.py
nodes.summary: Environment validator and installer; syncs the lock with uv pip sync, is backend-aware, refuses system-Python installs and hard-errors the CUDA path on 3.13+.

nodes.label: codes/extract_data.py
nodes.summary: Unzips requirements/*.zip into data/ and generates annotations; validates archive member names before extraction.

nodes.label: codes/preprocess_data.py
nodes.summary: Converts raw TIFF to Celsius, crops to the bounding box, resizes and stores .npy plus masks, metadata.csv and preprocess_manifest.json.

nodes.label: codes/hardware_detector.py
nodes.summary: Sole authority for device, per-model batch sizes, worker count and AMP strategy; CPU profile is behind UBENCH_ALLOW_CPU=1 and it no longer touches cuDNN flags.

nodes.label: codes/unified_data.py
nodes.summary: Config loader, S1-S10 discovery and ID namespacing, split metadata, fold-count resolution and the seeded GroupKFold loader factories.

nodes.label: codes/unified_training.py
nodes.summary: UnifiedTrainer: the shared train/validate loop, CombinedLoss, gradient clipping, NaN protection, per-epoch checkpointing and val-mIoU checkpoint selection.

nodes.label: codes/benchmark_models.py
nodes.summary: Cross-model comparison: loads fold checkpoints, computes CV and TEST metrics, timed inference, the fixed-batch VRAM probe, plots and the benchmark report.

nodes.label: codes/unet_v2.py
nodes.summary: U-Net architecture, registry key 'unet', trained from scratch.

nodes.label: codes/transunet.py
nodes.summary: From-scratch TransUNet, registry key 'transunet'; retained as an explicitly scoped small-data baseline after UB-16.

nodes.label: codes/swin_unet_plus_plus.py
nodes.summary: From-scratch Swin-UNet++, registry key 'swin_unet_plus_plus'; kept only as a historical baseline with known-defective attention (UB-17).

nodes.label: codes/pretrained_stem.py
nodes.summary: 1-channel stem adaptation for pretrained encoders; sum_rgb_kernels sums the pretrained RGB kernels so thermal input reuses ImageNet weights.

nodes.label: codes/generate_boxes_polygons.py
nodes.summary: Annotation generator: resolves the landmark scheme per row, derives the visible facial side for profile frames, and rasterizes polygon masks.

nodes.label: codes/naming.py
nodes.summary: Single filename authority: checkpoint_path(output_dir, model_key, fold, kind) used by both trainer and benchmark.

nodes.label: codes/metrics.py
nodes.summary: The one hard-metric authority: argmax IoU and Dice derived from torchmetrics.ConfusionMatrix, macro excluding absent classes, background reported separately.

nodes.label: codes/config_schema.py
nodes.summary: Typed pydantic schema with extra='forbid' validating codes/config.yaml at import time; also hosts resolve_recipe for per-family recipes.

nodes.label: codes/utils.py
nodes.summary: Holds apply_normalization, the single load-time normalization authority, plus normalize_thermal and visualization helpers.

nodes.label: codes/augmentation.py
nodes.summary: Single augmentation authority: build_thermal_transform composes LateralAwareHorizontalFlip, A.Affine and ThermalSensorNoise on the Celsius array with a seeded A.Compose.

nodes.label: codes/tests/
nodes.summary: The committed CPU-only test suite; the smoke test is the merge gate and every ledger fix keeps a regression test here.

nodes.label: codes/tests/conftest.py
nodes.summary: Hosts the session-scoped synthetic_dataset fixture (S1-S5, 4 frames each, one border bbox with min_x=3) and fixes seeds.

nodes.label: synthetic_dataset fixture
nodes.summary: Miniature but structurally faithful dataset in tmp_path: 5 subjects x 4 64x64 uint16 frames, Portuguese region keys, and a border bbox as the UB-08 tripwire.

nodes.label: test_pipeline_smoke.py
nodes.summary: The E2E gate and the definition of 'the repo works': runs main_pipeline as a subprocess on the fixture and asserts a 3-model benchmark CSV.

nodes.label: test_hardware_cpu.py
nodes.summary: Verifies the CPU hardware profile behind the UBENCH_ALLOW_CPU=1 opt-in.

nodes.label: test_filenames.py
nodes.summary: Round-trips the train<->benchmark checkpoint path contract.

nodes.label: test_splits.py
nodes.summary: Fold-count guard and subject exclusivity: reduced K with a warning at 2-3 subjects, actionable error at 1, no subject in both train and val.

nodes.label: test_preprocess_offsets.py
nodes.summary: Border-bbox mask alignment; red before the fix with a 28 px centroid offset, green after, with an aligned control bbox.

nodes.label: test_failure_honesty.py
nodes.summary: Injected failure yields exit 1, a summary naming model and fold, an error_log file, and --fail-fast aborts before fold 2.

nodes.label: test_resume.py
nodes.summary: Two-phase --resume: metric history continues, no second run dir is minted, outputs/latest resolves, unknown run id fails actionably.

nodes.label: test_run_identity.py
nodes.summary: --epochs honored end to end, UBENCH_RUN_ID reuse, and --resume precedence over the env id.

nodes.label: test_batch_size_keys.py
nodes.summary: Hard [key] lookup and per-tier batch values, with key parity between every tier and the model registry.

nodes.label: test_config.py
nodes.summary: Unknown key and wrong type raise, the shipped file validates, batch_sizes is rejected, and each wired key visibly changes the constructed trainer.

nodes.label: test_timing.py
nodes.summary: Warm-up arithmetic, synchronize called exactly twice on CUDA and zero on CPU, and validate() returning no inference times.

nodes.label: test_metrics.py
nodes.summary: Hard IoU/Dice equal hand-computed values, absent classes excluded from the macro, background separate, one shared authority, accumulation batch-invariant.

nodes.label: test_models_forward.py
nodes.summary: Every registered key maps (2,1,256,256) to (2,10,256,256) offline, plus the stem-sum unit test, a train step and the network-gated pretrained-load proof.

nodes.label: test_memory.py
nodes.summary: Fixed probe batch regardless of the training batch, CPU returns None rather than a fabricated 0, and a resident baseline sweep of 0/400/1024 MB demands a constant answer.

nodes.label: test_test_subjects.py
nodes.summary: Two-directional exclusivity of held-out subjects, hard errors for an absent id or a holdout leaving fewer than 2 CV subjects, and an unchanged empty default.

nodes.label: test_determinism.py
nodes.summary: seed_worker determinism per worker id, a NUM_WORKERS=2 spawn test showing the seeded generator pins the stream, and collect_run_metadata provenance.

nodes.label: test_utils.py
nodes.summary: Covers normalize_thermal returning zeros when min equals max.

nodes.label: test_recipes.py
nodes.summary: resolve_recipe behaviour, shipped family assignments, warmup arithmetic, the scheduler-cadence contract, mIoU-based selection and the resume mismatch hard error.

nodes.label: test_preprocessing.py
nodes.summary: Both normalization modes, the manifest version guard, the resize-commutation difference and the vectorized raw->°C speedup.

nodes.label: test_augmentation.py
nodes.summary: Physical additive augmentation and same-seed reproducibility, plus six lateral-flip tests whose headline case is red against plain A.HorizontalFlip and green after.

nodes.label: test_cli.py
nodes.summary: Proves every registered model key parses through argparse and that an unknown key errors.

nodes.label: test_landmark_mapping.py
nodes.summary: A 73-column header with a 43-filled row resolves to the 43-point scheme, unknown counts raise, both facing directions are pinned and the never-share-coordinates invariant holds.

nodes.label: test_all_models_registered
nodes.summary: Pins the five-key model registry so registration drift is caught.

nodes.label: pyproject.toml
nodes.summary: The single dependency source of truth ([project] table) plus ruff and pytest tooling config.

nodes.label: requirements/requirements.cpu.lock
nodes.summary: Committed CPU lock compiled at the 3.10 requires-python floor with --torch-backend=cpu; CI and dev install from it via uv pip sync.

nodes.label: benchmark_comparison.csv
nodes.summary: Per-model comparison table written under outputs/<run_id>/, carrying CV and TEST sections and the fixed-batch VRAM column.

nodes.label: run_metadata.json
nodes.summary: Per-run provenance: git SHA and dirty flag, torch/CUDA versions, GPU, seed, determinism, effective config, active recipe, normalization mode and lockfile sha256.

nodes.label: data/processed/preprocess_manifest.json
nodes.summary: Records preprocess_version; a missing or stale manifest hard-errors at load so legacy [0,1] data is never misread as Celsius.

nodes.label: data/processed/metadata.csv
nodes.summary: Index of preprocessed samples; its absence triggers automatic preprocessing in the pipeline.

nodes.label: outputs/latest
nodes.summary: Symlink atomically replaced to point at the newest run directory.

nodes.label: error_log_*.txt
nodes.summary: Traceback dump written when a run records a failure; a failed run exits non-zero with this file present.

nodes.label: logs/<run_id>/pipeline.log
nodes.summary: Full pipeline console log written solely by Python's TeeLogger; the shell's own capture goes to console.log.

nodes.label: UnifiedTrainer
nodes.summary: The shared train/validate loop every model goes through, which is what makes cross-model numbers comparable.

nodes.label: CombinedLoss
nodes.summary: Combined Cross-Entropy + Dice criterion; the single definition of 'loss' for both training and the benchmark.

nodes.label: Config
nodes.summary: Loads codes/config.yaml through the pydantic schema; the single configuration entry point for the pipeline.

nodes.label: MultiDirectoryDataLoader
nodes.summary: Scans data/ for S1-S10, merges them and prefixes sample IDs by source dataset to keep them unique.

nodes.label: resolve_fold_count
nodes.summary: Reduces k_folds to the subject count with a loud warning and raises an actionable error below 2 subjects.

nodes.label: load_split_metadata
nodes.summary: Removes the configured test subjects from the CV pool so the fold guard and both loader factories only see the training pool.

nodes.label: create_test_loader
nodes.summary: Yields exactly the held-out test subjects for the benchmark's TEST section.

nodes.label: create_single_fold_loader
nodes.summary: Lazy one-fold-at-a-time loader factory the pipeline uses to avoid worker/semaphore leaks.

nodes.label: checkpoint_path
nodes.summary: checkpoint_path(output_dir, model_key, fold, kind) — the one function both trainer and benchmark call to build weight paths.

nodes.label: probe_peak_memory
nodes.summary: Fixed-batch inference VRAM probe reporting own parameters plus working-set delta after a discarded warm-up forward; returns None on CPU.

nodes.label: timed_inference
nodes.summary: Latency helper that discards warm-up batches and brackets measurement with cuda.synchronize, disclosing its conditions in the report.

nodes.label: SegmentationMetrics
nodes.summary: The shared metric object resolved identically by trainer and benchmark; hard argmax IoU and Dice with batch-invariant accumulation.

nodes.label: apply_normalization
nodes.summary: Single load-time normalization authority implementing fixed_range and per_image_minmax over the Celsius array.

nodes.label: build_thermal_transform
nodes.summary: Single augmentation authority; composes the lateral-aware flip, A.Affine and ThermalSensorNoise under a seeded A.Compose before normalization.

nodes.label: ThermalSensorNoise
nodes.summary: Physical augmentation applying additive sensor drift in °C plus Gaussian noise, replacing the physically dubious RandomBrightnessContrast.

nodes.label: LateralAwareHorizontalFlip
nodes.summary: Flip transform overriding apply_to_mask to mirror and permute the lateral class pairs atomically, so relabelling cannot desynchronise from the flip.

nodes.label: lateral_index_pairs
nodes.summary: Derives the lateral class index pairs from the ordered config.regions; an unpaired lateral class raises, and region_names is a required argument.

nodes.label: generate_boxes_polygons._LATERAL_PAIRS
nodes.summary: The lateral-token table in the annotation generator, pinned by test to agree with lateral_index_pairs.

nodes.label: sum_rgb_kernels
nodes.summary: Adapts a pretrained 3-channel stem to 1-channel thermal input by summing the RGB kernels; proven equal to the hub's summed stem.

nodes.label: resolve_recipe
nodes.summary: Resolves the optimizer/scheduler recipe per model key from the recipes config; unmapped models inherit the global recipe and an unknown family is a hard error.

nodes.label: seed_worker
nodes.summary: DataLoader worker_init_fn seeding numpy and random per worker, deterministic per worker id and distinct across ids.

nodes.label: seed_everything
nodes.summary: The single seeding owner; when deterministic is true it also owns cudnn.deterministic=True and cudnn.benchmark=False.

nodes.label: collect_run_metadata
nodes.summary: Gathers the per-run provenance written to run_metadata.json.

nodes.label: @register_model
nodes.summary: Decorator that puts an nn.Module into the model registry under its canonical key; the registry is the authority for CLI choices and batch-size parity.

nodes.label: get_registered_models
nodes.summary: Returns the registry keys from which the --models argparse choices are derived, plus an explicit 'swin' alias.

nodes.label: raw_to_celsius
nodes.summary: Array-native raw->°C conversion ((raw/100)-273.15) that replaced the per-pixel np.vectorize loop, at least 100x faster.

nodes.label: crop_to_bbox
nodes.summary: Crops to the padded bounding box and returns the clamped origin so the polygon offset uses the same origin as the crop.

nodes.label: ThermalFaceDataset
nodes.summary: Dataset that verifies the preprocess manifest in _read_all_metadata and applies normalization at load time.

nodes.label: detect_and_optimize
nodes.summary: Profiles the GPU at pipeline start and picks per-model batch sizes, worker count and AMP strategy by tier.

nodes.label: UnifiedTrainer._find_latest_checkpoint
nodes.summary: Locates the newest epoch checkpoint in the run's dir so --resume continues rather than restarting.

nodes.label: apply_epochs_override
nodes.summary: Exports the CLI --epochs value as NUM_EPOCHS whenever the flag is given, unconditionally after UB-13.

nodes.label: normalize_thermal
nodes.summary: Legacy per-image normalizer that now returns zeros when min equals max instead of an un-normalized image.

nodes.label: LANDMARK_MAPPINGS_43
nodes.summary: The 43-point profile landmark mapping; dead code until UB-27 was fixed, and its double-booked lateral indices are UB-29.

nodes.label: _resolve_landmark_mapping
nodes.summary: Picks the landmark scheme from the count of landmarks each row actually fills; an unknown count raises instead of defaulting to 73.

nodes.label: _resolve_visible_side
nodes.summary: Derives which facial side survives into a profile frame from landmark geometry; the ±0.15 ambiguous band raises.

nodes.label: _drop_occluded_side
nodes.summary: Omits the unannotated lateral side of a profile frame rather than duplicating the visible one.

nodes.label: unet (U-Net)
nodes.summary: From-scratch CNN, registry key 'unet', display name U-Net, 31.0M params; assigned to the cnn family (Adam + ReduceLROnPlateau).

nodes.label: transunet (TransUNet)
nodes.summary: From-scratch ViT-B TransUNet, 105.7M params, retained as a scoped small-data baseline; transformer family recipe.

nodes.label: swin_unet_plus_plus (Swin-UNet++)
nodes.summary: From-scratch Swin-UNet++, 40.9M params, kept only as a defective-attention historical baseline; transformer family recipe.

nodes.label: swin_pretrained
nodes.summary: timm SwinV2-tiny encoder plus conv decoder (~35M), ImageNet-pretrained, opt-in via --models; transformer family recipe.

nodes.label: transunet_pretrained
nodes.summary: timm R50+ViT-B/16 hybrid plus upsampling decoder (~99M), the heaviest model, ImageNet-pretrained and opt-in.

nodes.label: model registry
nodes.summary: Five canonical keys that serve as the single authority for file I/O, dict keys, batch-size parity and CLI choices.

nodes.label: UBENCH_RUN_ID
nodes.summary: Shared run identity exported by run.sh/run.bat so shell and Python produce exactly one outputs/ and logs/ pair per invocation.

nodes.label: UBENCH_ALLOW_CPU
nodes.summary: Explicit opt-in that lets hardware detection return a CPU profile instead of exiting, enabling CI E2E.

nodes.label: UBENCH_PRETRAINED
nodes.summary: Gates pretrained weight download; set to 0 to build the identical architecture with random weights, which is what tests and the CPU smoke do.

nodes.label: UBENCH_DETERMINISTIC
nodes.summary: Overrides the deterministic config flag at runtime.

nodes.label: UBENCH_TORCH_BACKEND
nodes.summary: Selects the torch wheel index (cpu|cu121|cu118) for setup.py's lock-driven install, overriding driver auto-detection.

nodes.label: NUM_EPOCHS
nodes.summary: Overrides the configured epoch budget; the channel through which --epochs reaches the config.

nodes.label: TEST_SUBJECTS
nodes.summary: Comma-separated override for the held-out test subjects.

nodes.label: LIMIT_SAMPLES
nodes.summary: Truncates metadata rows for fast dev loops.

nodes.label: --resume RUN_ID
nodes.summary: Reuses an existing run's outputs and logs dirs and continues from its epoch checkpoints; takes precedence over UBENCH_RUN_ID.

nodes.label: --fail-fast
nodes.summary: Aborts the run on the first recorded training failure instead of continuing.

nodes.label: --force-preprocess
nodes.summary: Rebuilds data/processed unconditionally; named in the hard error raised for a missing or stale preprocess manifest.

nodes.label: --models
nodes.summary: Selects which registered models to train; choices are derived from the registry with an explicit swin alias.

nodes.label: --epochs N
nodes.summary: Overrides the configured epoch count; default=None so any explicit value including 100 is honored.

nodes.label: leave-subjects-out cross-validation
nodes.summary: GroupKFold(groups=df['dataset']) holds out whole subject directories per fold, the correct choice for face data where frames of one person are near-duplicates.

nodes.label: held-out test subjects
nodes.summary: Opt-in subjects excluded from every CV fold and scored by each fold-model; CV selects, TEST headlines, and nothing is ever tuned on test.

nodes.label: fixed_range normalization
nodes.summary: Maps [20,40]°C linearly to [0,1], preserving absolute temperature and commuting with resize; the shipped default.

nodes.label: per_image_minmax normalization
nodes.summary: Legacy per-frame min-max that destroys absolute temperature and does not commute with resize, so its numbers shifted when normalization moved to load time.

nodes.label: warmup_cosine scheduler
nodes.summary: Linear warmup then cosine decay, stepped once per optimizer step with no argument; passing a positional arg would be read as an epoch index and silently corrupt the LR.

nodes.label: ReduceLROnPlateau scheduler
nodes.summary: Plateau scheduler stepped once per epoch with the validation metric; the cnn family's scheduler.

nodes.label: scheduler stepping cadence contract
nodes.summary: Kind-specific and load-bearing: plateau steps per epoch with the metric, warmup_cosine steps per optimizer step without one. Violating it corrupts the LR silently.

nodes.label: checkpoint selection by val mIoU
nodes.summary: The best checkpoint is the epoch with the highest validation mIoU (the headline metric), not the lowest val loss, which is still logged.

nodes.label: per-family optimizer/scheduler recipes
nodes.summary: CNN family uses Adam + plateau; the transformer family uses AdamW (wd 0.05) + warmup->cosine with grad-clip 1.0, disclosed as the fairness mechanism.

nodes.label: resume recipe-mismatch guard
nodes.summary: The checkpoint records its recipe and --resume hard-errors on a mismatch, so an AdamW state is never loaded into Adam.

nodes.label: paired Wilcoxon signed-rank test
nodes.summary: Required alongside mean±std on held-out subjects before any 'outperforms' claim; otherwise the wording is 'comparable within noise'.

nodes.label: the smoke test (merge gate)
nodes.summary: Runs the pipeline as a subprocess on the synthetic fixture with LIMIT_SAMPLES/NUM_EPOCHS/K_FOLDS/NUM_WORKERS pinned and asserts a 3-model benchmark CSV; it guards UB-01/02/03/05/07.

nodes.label: timm
nodes.summary: The library supplying the correct pretrained encoders (SwinV2-tiny, R50+ViT-B/16) and the in_chans=1 stem adaptation.

nodes.label: albumentations <2.0 pin
nodes.summary: Pinned because 2.0.8 rejects ShiftScaleRotate(value=...); the API migration to A.Affine landed in T3.4 while the pin was retained.

nodes.label: pydantic config schema (extra=forbid)
nodes.summary: Validates codes/config.yaml at import time so an unknown key or wrong-typed value raises a ValueError at startup instead of being silently ignored.

nodes.label: mixed precision (AMP)
nodes.summary: Chosen by hardware tier; GTX-class cards and CPUs get AMP disabled, and it must not be disabled for memory-constrained GPUs generally.

nodes.label: GTX 1660 Ti 6 GB baseline tier
nodes.summary: The minimum supported GPU and the tier the batch-size table is calibrated against.

nodes.label: the four lateralised classes
nodes.summary: Sombrancelha esquerda/direita (2/3) and Olho esquerdo/direito (5/6); UB-27, UB-29 and UB-30 all corrupt exactly these, by different mechanisms.

nodes.label: image-side (not anatomical) label naming
nodes.summary: 'Olho esquerdo' holds the smaller x in 99.9% of 4225 frontal rows, so the labels name the side of the image, which is why a flip must permute them.

nodes.label: Session Entry Protocol
nodes.summary: Every session verifies the predecessor's claimed end-state from the working tree before new work; a failed check halts the session.

nodes.label: Project Definition of Done
nodes.summary: Fresh clone -> ./run.sh -> a 3-model benchmark CSV with zero manual steps, CI green, every README claim executable, and test-subject metrics with disclosed budgets.
